title: Cozy Bungalow-walk to Hillsboro Village/12 South
description:
Enjoy a cozy & quiet stay at this centrally-located bungalow apartment in the idyllic Hillsboro West End neighborhood
      
• 10 min to downtown / 7 min to Greenhills 
• Short walk to Vanderbilt, Belmont & Hillsboro Village
• 15-20 min walk (3min drive) to 12 South 
• Across the street from the iconic Brown’s Diner (food and local music)
• Next door to Kroger Grocery
• We will provide a visitors guide with our favorite local spots, upon arrival
• Quiet, historic neighborhood

The space
If you are looking for a well designed, cozy space, look no further.  Our home is a lovely 1928 cottage, so it has all of the quirks but also all of the charm.  If you are looking for a white, sterile box, Blair Bungalow is not for you. Also note, the entrance is on the 2nd floor so there are two flights of stairs to the unit.  

• 1 queen bed in bedroom (blinds + curtains - not blackout) 
• 1 twin bed in sleeping nook, off kitchen/ living space. Bed is tucked behind curtains.  Additional curtains in living space are heavily lined

• 1 bathroom with shower / tub 

• (2) 34” tv’s - (1) in bedroom and (1) in living space 
• Dining table can also serve as workspace 

• Whole Home water filtration system - on all faucets 

• Kitchenette 
    - Coffee - Keurig (hot or cold) - pods provided 
    - coffee grinder (beans not provided) 
    -Fridge / small freezer
    -Air frier / toaster oven 
    - Microwave 
    - Sink
    - Dishes / cutlery provided 

• Spacious deck with (4)  Adirondack chairs

• Closet to store luggage

Guest access
Keypad Entry. Apartment is above our home, but has its own entrance, lounging porch, & parking spot in driveway.

Other things to note
When coming and going, please be mindful of noise levels. The homes around us are also full time residents, so please be respectful.
